title: Celestial Dream Weaver
description: A mystical woman in a flowing cosmic gown stands in a glowing stream, reaching toward ethereal fish-like spirits that swirl in colorful aurora trails. She is surrounded by a surreal night forest with luminous trees bearing glowing orbs, floating silhouettes, and magical flowers under a starry sky.
prompt: A mystical woman with long flowing dark hair stands in a glowing stream at night, wearing a sparkling cosmic gown that blends into the water. She reaches out with one hand toward swirling ethereal fish-like spirits that trail colorful aurora smoke in pink, purple, green and gold. A large magical tree with glowing orbs and leaves arches overhead, surrounded by floating silhouettes, luminous flowers and a starry cosmic sky, in a dreamy surreal fantasy style.
